title: Echo 1.8.13
notes:
Filter remixes and edited versions out of Home Trending.

- Excludes tracks labeled as remixes, mashups, reworks, bootlegs, slowed/sped-up versions, nightcore, reverb, bass boosts, 8D audio, and DJ/club/radio edits.
- Checks title and artist metadata for both the year-based searches and current country chart.
- Applies the filter before selecting search results, allowing further pages to supply eligible songs. Keeps saved no-repeat recommendation history.

Filtering uses catalog metadata; an edit without a recognizable label cannot be reliably identified.

Android 8.0+; package com.dev.music; version code 50; same development signing key. APK checksum is included in SHA256SUMS.txt and GitHub's asset digest.
